description: What you need to install a skill: the address of its zip, the folder the zip holds, and each file's path, address, size and SHA-256. Fetch the zip and unpack it into your skills folder, or fetch each file and write it under the skill's folder. Nothing of the files rides in this result. If you cannot fetch an address, read each file with read at its address. With the user's key the skill counts as the user's own copy, counted once. A Workotron workflow is added in the Workotron app, and take says how.

address.description: The skill's address, full or as its path: `unpaid-invoice-chaser`.

name: take
title: Take a skill
